issues.description: The template defines a function named simulate_one_round(...) but the problem specification and the solution use the name simulate_msd_one_round(...). plot_msd in the template also calls simulate_msd_one_round(...). This name mismatch will prevent students from implementing the required function under the expected name and will cause runtime / test failures or confusion about which function to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template function simulate_one_round(...) to simulate_msd_one_round(...) (and update any internal references) so its name and signature match the problem specification and the solution. Ensure the placeholder NotImplementedError message is updated accordingly.

issues.description: The one-round simulation function is named simulate_msd_one_round in the problem statement and in the solution, but the template defines it as simulate_one_round. This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual function (simulate one round of MSD) can confuse students and break references from other code (e.g., plotting helpers) that call simulate_msd_one_round.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the function in the template from simulate_one_round to simulate_msd_one_round (or alternatively update the problem statement and solution to use simulate_one_round) so that the identifier consistently matches across problem, template, and solution. Also update any internal calls (e.g., plot_msd) to use the same name.
